description: Use this when asking 'Why does my basement get wet whenever it rains?' or 'Can you help me narrow down where basement water is coming from and who fixes it?'. Eight observation groups return every rule-matched possible cause, evidence, safe first checks, trade referrals and sources. Hazard stops come first; no probabilities or structural diagnosis. Pure rules, no network or model. (API Tool Calls, by Cowerx)
